sources.observation: Pipeline separates segmentation from finish stages; finish clones cached segmentation, applies color fitters and compositing before optimizer passes, and supports cancellation/progress.

sources.readScope: Lines1-200; refit and junction invariants, not remaining sampling implementation
sources.observation: Simplification pins shared junction endpoints, splits at tangent corners and refits sampled cubic runs only when node count decreases. The stated tolerance is measured at samples, not a continuous bound.

sources.readScope: Lines1-200; selected writer and subpath state
sources.observation: SVG writer preserves painter order while grouping consecutive fills, chooses relative/absolute commands and resets current point to initial subpath on Close.
Source regression checks fitted handles against on-curve bounds with overshoot allowance on stacked and cutout cityscape tracing. Test was read, not executed.
VTracer crate has visioncortex and flo_curves runtime dependencies; resvg/image are test-only. No binary was vendored.
USD camera local axes are +X right,+Y up,-Z view regardless of stage up axis. Optical lengths use tenths of stage unit.
Stage metrics default centimetres/Y up; explicit up-axis and metres-per-unit are important, and assembled references with differing metrics need corrective transforms.

sources.readScope: Selected declarations and CPU alpha-over functions lines1-155
sources.observation: Alpha Over distinguishes straight versus premultiplied foreground and computes foreground plus background scaled by one minus foreground alpha, then interpolates by factor.
